title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures steady after Treasury's bond intervention buoys markets
title_zh: 今日股市：美国财政部债券干预提振市场后，道指、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货稳定
summary: Markets continued to assess the implications of the Treasury's bond buyback plans, Trump's economic warfare plans, and the national debt above $40 trillion.
summary_zh: 市场继续评估财政部债券回购计划、特朗普经济战计划以及超过40万亿美元的国债的影响。

title: Australia passes law to levy tech giants that fail to pay for local news
title_zh: 澳大利亚通过法律对未能支付当地新闻费用的科技巨头征税
summary: Australia passed legislation on Thursday that will force tech giants to pay millions of dollars in ‌levies if they fail to strike commercial deals with local ‌media outlets for news on their platforms.
summary_zh: 澳大利亚周四通过立法，如果科技巨头未能与当地媒体就其平台上的新闻达成商业协议，将迫使科技巨头缴纳数百万美元的税款。

title: Wall St rises as yields ease, Moderna lifts healthcare stocks
title_zh: 随着收益率下降，华尔街上涨，Moderna 提振医疗保健股
summary: VIDEO SHOWS: n/aSTORY: Wall Street's main indexes closed modestly higher on Wednesday, with the Dow, S&P 500 and the Nasdaq all adding less than a quarter of a percent.Risk appetite got a boost from easing government bond yields.
summary_zh: 视频显示：无故事：周三华尔街主要股指小幅收高，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克指数均上涨不到 25%。政府债券收益率的放松提振了风险偏好。

title: Amazon Prime Air maybe coming to a city near you
title_zh: Amazon Prime Air 可能会来到您附近的城市
summary: Amazon (AMZN) is taking Prime Air to the next level. The tech and retail giant plans to expand its drone delivery service to nearly 500 U.S. cities and towns by the end of 2026, roughly a sixfold increase over its current footprint.
summary_zh: 亚马逊 (AMZN) 正在将 Prime Air 提升到一个新的水平。这家科技和零售巨头计划到 2026 年底将其无人机送货服务扩展到近 500 个美国城镇，比目前的覆盖范围大约增加六倍。

title: If Walmart doesn't raise its outlook, the stock will fall: CFRA Research
title_zh: CFRA Research：如果沃尔玛不提高前景，该股将会下跌
summary: Walmart (WMT) reports second quarter earnings on Thursday before the opening bell. CFRA Research senior vice president of equity research Arun Sundaram shares his expectations for the earnings print.
summary_zh: 沃尔玛（WMT）将于周四开盘前报告第二季度收益。 CFRA Research 股票研究高级副总裁 Arun Sundaram 分享了他对财报的预期。

title: Is Nvidia stock too cheap right now?
title_zh: 英伟达的股票现在太便宜了吗？
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) reports earnings next week, on August 26th. Ahead of the print, Bank of America (BAC) says the AI chip giant could be significantly undervalued relative to its peers.
summary_zh: 英伟达 (NVDA) 将于下周 8 月 26 日公布财报。在印刷之前，美国银行（BAC）表示，相对于同行，这家人工智能芯片巨头的估值可能被严重低估。

title: Tech sell-off resumes, counterbalancing bond yield relief: AlphaCheck
title_zh: 科技股抛售恢复，抵消了债券收益率的下降：AlphaCheck
summary: Tech stocks faced renewed selling pressure, while healthcare, basic materials, and consumer discretionary stocks rose.
summary_zh: 科技股面临新的抛售压力，而医疗保健、基本材料和非必需消费品股票则上涨。

title: There's 'light at the end of the tunnel' for tech stocks amid bond rout: Eric Jackson
title_zh: 债券溃败之际，科技股迎来了“隧道尽头的曙光”：埃里克·杰克逊
summary: As bond yields (^TYX, ^TNX, ^FVX) continue to surge ahead, EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre outline the impact this is having on Big Tech stocks and AI hyperscalers.
summary_zh: 随着债券收益率（^TYX、^TNX、^FVX）继续飙升，EMJ Capital 创始人兼总裁 Eric Jackson 和雅虎金融市场和数据编辑 Jared Blikre 概述了这对大型科技股和人工智能超大规模企业的影响。

title: Forget the Mag 7: The phase 2 AI trade is here
title_zh: 忘记 Mag 7：第二阶段人工智能交易已经到来
summary: Host Kenny Polcari joins Academy Securities' Peter Tchir and Wall Street Alliance Group's Aadil Zaman to break down the shift toward production for security, how to hedge geopolitical risks using the energy sector, and why the real AI money is moving into phase 2 industrial be...
summary_zh: 主持人 Kenny Polcari 与 Academy Securities 的 Peter Tchir 和华尔街联盟集团的 Aadil Zaman 一起探讨了向安全生产的转变、如何利用能源部门对冲地缘政治风险，以及为什么真正的人工智能资金正在进入第二阶段工业领域。
